name: Innovation Ultimate

categories.label: Won the game
categories.hint: Mark the winner (achievements, score, card effect or elimination).

categories.label: Achievements claimed
categories.hint: Needed: 6 for 2 players, minus 1 per extra player (min 3), plus 1 per expansion.

categories.label: Score pile total
categories.hint: Sum of the ages of all cards in your score pile; only decides a game that ends by drawing past age 11.

tiebreakers.description: Score victory: highest score wins; tie goes to most achievements; still tied is a draw.

winCondition: First to claim the required number of achievements wins immediately; or a card effect ends the game; or last player standing. If the age-11 deck is exhausted (a draw above age 11 is attempted), the highest score pile wins, then most achievements, then draw.

endCondition.description: Game ends instantly on achievement victory, card-effect victory, elimination, or attempt to draw above age 11 (score victory).

notes: family: objective-race. Achievements needed for team games and large games differ (8 plus adjustments for 4+ player large games); see rulebook Team/Large Games section. Expansion-specific victory rules not modelled. Rulebook version is v0.9 proof.

sources.title: Innovation Ultimate Rulebook v0.9
